verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents compliance-status notifications, annual-report deadline reminders, and a Compliance Calendar, but all are delivered by email or through a human-facing dashboard. The pack shows no API or registrable webhook an agent could use to monitor entity standing or deadlines programmatically. Human-facing reminders and an llms.txt crawler guidance file are adjacent features, not the API/webhook capability the story requires.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
